replication.target_description: Registered multilab direct replication of Experiment 3; random-effects meta-analysis of criminal intentionality, imperfective minus perfective; Figure 1 on article p. 6 (journal p. 163). MTurk variant and original study are excluded from the meta-analysis.

n.sample_role: Laboratory replication studies contributing study-level estimates to the meta-analysis; not a participant count. A pooled analytic participant total is not explicitly printed in the located result.
n.exclusions: Meta-analysis excludes the original study and the online MTurk variant. Participant exclusions vary by laboratory and are documented in Table 1 and Appendix B; no pooled participant total derived.

notes: The neutral description is broad, but replication p. 6 uniquely presents Figure 1 for criminal intentionality, so the paired original result is d = 0.76, not the distinct Mind Attribution Scale result d = 0.66. Original publication is 2011 (online December 2010), consistent with the supplied DOI. Replication Figure 1 prints −0.24 [−0.50, 0.02]; adjacent prose instead gives an opposite-direction difference of 0.24 and CI −0.49 to 0.03. Figure values retained as printed. No p value for the pooled target mean difference is printed in the located result; the p = .045 nearby tests heterogeneity and is not the target effect test. No conversions or pooled participant-N sums performed. Both primary PDF titles and DOIs verified. Sources acquired from original-author and replication-author websites after publisher DOI landing pages returned 403; no challenge retries or paid routes used.
